CustomField.description: The donor-facing display name for this donor tier. Referenced by the DonorGiftSummary formula fields FQS_Annual_Donor_Level_Name__c and FQS_Lifetime_Donor_Level_Name__c. Change this value to rebrand tier names (e.g., "Friend" to "Community Member") across all Donor Gift Summary records without redeployment.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The organization's specific naming structure for public donor recognition. Changing this value here automatically updates FQS_*_Donor_Level_Name__c on all Donor Gift Summary records. Example values: Friend, Partner, Champion or Entry, Rising, Summit.
CustomField.label: Donor Tier
